rag.note: Includes LLM generation time. See retrieval_only for pure retrieval latency.

retrieval_only.note: Total latency includes LLM generation. warm_min_ms is best proxy for retrieval+embed path when LLM response time is consistent.

cache.note: Speedup > 1 means cache is reducing embedding latency. Speedup < 1 means LLM variance dominates and cache effect is masked.

ingestion.note: Total elapsed includes GitHub clone over network. chunks_per_sec_incl_clone is a conservative floor; pure parse+embed throughput is higher.
